title.ja: 同じ非線形反応拡散でLie–TrotterとStrangを比較する
title.en: Lie–Trotter versus Strang on the same nonlinear reaction–diffusion input

summary.ja: 32格子・終了時刻1のSchnakenberg反応拡散を、同じ入力・部分ソルバーでLie–TrotterとStrangにより進めます。4段階の時間刻みで1次／2次の収束、参照の感度、反応収支と未収束時の失敗を確かめる軽量な比較例です。
summary.en: Advance a 32-point Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion problem to T=1 with matched inputs and subsolvers. Four step sizes check first-/second-order temporal convergence, reference sensitivity, reaction balance and failure on nonconvergence in a lightweight comparison.

assumptions.ja: 無次元の1D周期区間[0,2π)、N=32、a=.1,b=.9、D=(.01,1)。u₀=1+.08cos2x+.01cos4x、v₀=.9−.03cos2x−.002cos4xは既存の有限振幅例と同じ初期場です。今回の終時刻はT=1、ステップ数16/32/64/128、共通出力時刻0/.25/.5/.75/1。反射対称・π周期の限定入力です。
assumptions.en: Nondimensional 1D periodic [0,2pi), N=32, a=.1, b=.9, D=(.01,1). The initial fields u₀=1+.08cos2x+.01cos4x and v₀=.9−.03cos2x−.002cos4x match the earlier finite-amplitude example. This new run ends at T=1, uses 16/32/64/128 steps and common output times 0/.25/.5/.75/1. The fixed input is reflection-even and pi-periodic.

algorithm.ja: Lie–Trotterは拡散h→反応h、Strangは拡散h/2→反応h→拡散h/2。どちらも更新後の状態を次へ渡します。拡散は2次中心FD行列の指数をFFTで厳密適用、反応は同じ陰的中点則・Newton公差2e−13・上限12評価を使用。反応流は厳密解ではなく2次近似です。クリッピング・自動刻み変更・代替解法への切替を行わず、未収束は失敗にします。
algorithm.en: Lie–Trotter uses diffusion(h) then reaction(h); Strang uses diffusion(h/2), reaction(h), diffusion(h/2), always passing the updated state. Both apply the exact exponential of the centered-FD diffusion matrix by FFT and the same implicit-midpoint reaction/Newton tolerance 2e−13 with at most 12 residual evaluations. The reaction flow is a second-order approximation, not exact. No clipping, adaptive steps or fallback; nonconvergence is failure.

validation.ja: 参照は同じFD半離散系を実空間の疎行列・別記述の反応RHSで組み、分割せずRadauで積分した数値解です。Radauの公差細分化と別のDOP853で参照自身の差を測り、最細Strang誤差との比を判定します。ノルムは成分ごとの平均L1・RMS L2・最大L∞を求めて悪い成分を採用し、4つの正の共通出力時刻の最大値で次数を測定。Newton公差感度、全副段階の正濃度、反応source/sink収支と逆順Lieの対照も記録します。
validation.en: The reference independently assembles the SAME FD semidiscretization with a real-space sparse matrix and separately written reaction RHS, then integrates it unsplit with Radau. Tighter Radau and separate DOP853 runs measure reference sensitivity relative to the finest Strang error. Norms are per-species mean L1, RMS L2 and maximum L∞, then the worse species; refinement uses the maximum across the four common positive observation times. Also record Newton-tolerance sensitivity, positive tested substeps, reaction source/sink balance and reversed-Lie ordering.

limits.ja: 固定格子での採用合成法の時間誤差であり、分割誤差と反応中点則の離散誤差を含みます。連続PDEの厳密解・空間収束・独立PDE実装の照合とは呼びません。u+vは反応で保存せず、正濃度は固定入力での観測です。計算費は実際の部分流呼出し数で示し、速度の順位やStrangの一般的優越を主張しません。既存Schnakenberg問題の追加比較で、物理問題数・共通22例・旧配布版の公差や成功履歴を増減・変更しません。長時間パターン・2D・一般境界は対象外です。
limits.en: This measures temporal error of the adopted compositions at fixed space, including splitting and midpoint-reaction discretization errors. It is not an exact continuum solution, spatial convergence check or independent PDE-engine comparison. Reactions do not conserve u+v; positivity is observed only for the fixed input. Work is reported as actual subflow calls, without runtime rankings or universal Strang superiority. This additional comparison of the existing Schnakenberg problem changes neither physical-problem counts, the common 22 examples, old release criteria nor success history. Long-time patterns, 2D and general boundaries are outside scope.

formulas: \lambda_{h,k}=-\frac{4}{\Delta x^2}\sin^2\!\left(\frac{\pi k}{N}\right),\quad L_h=\Psi_R^h\circ e^{hD L_{\rm FD}},\quad S_h=e^{hD L_{\rm FD}/2}\circ\Psi_R^h\circ e^{hD L_{\rm FD}/2}

review.ja: PubMedの書誌・DOIと出版社索引の抄録を確認。原著本文は403で未取得。反応系の歴史的出典であり、a=.1,b=.9や今回の空間計算を原著の再現とは呼びません。
review.en: Checked official PubMed bibliography/DOI and publisher-indexed abstract. Full text returned403. Historical source for the reaction family, not a claim to reproduce original coefficients or experiments.

review.ja: SciPy 1.14.1公式資料のmethod・rtol/atolを参照。Radau 5次とDOP853 8次は同じ空間離散の独立した時間積分法として用い、連続PDEの厳密解とは呼びません。
review.en: Consulted SciPy 1.14.1 methods and rtol/atol documentation. Radau order five and DOP853 order eight are independent time algorithms for the same spatial system, not exact continuum solutions.

measured.reference_scope: Unsplit Radau and DOP853 integration of the SAME centered-FD semidiscrete equations. No continuum-PDE or spatial convergence validation.

scope.ja: 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。
scope.en: These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems.
